product: national operable merchantable-forest screening proxy v3
status: screening proxy combining operable proxy v2 with the national 960 m slope screen; NOT a legal THLB, AAC landbase, operability model, or yield forecast

method.combination: v2 base/core20/core30 operable area x published forest-weighted ecoprovince share_gt15/share_gt30
method.overlay_assumption: forest-weighted 960 m treed slope share applied to v2 operable area; assumes v2 screens are independent of slope within the province/ecoprovince; not pixel-exact; screening proxy, not legal THLB
method.core30_slope_basis: same ecoprovince share as base/core20; no independent published core30 overlay

intensity.reference_note: 119M is the v2/slope reference base path (118,977,339 m3/yr), rounded in the label.
intensity.note: Target volume divided by post-slope operable area. This is arithmetic only: not a growth/yield forecast, sustainability test, or AAC.

slope_coverage.handling: v2 nearest-ecoprovince attribution is inherited; the receiving ecoprovince slope share is applied. The gap is not zero-filled, extrapolated, or assigned independent slope statistics.

gaps.detail: No legal timber harvesting landbase boundary is used. Tenure is a rights footprint, not a harvest-landbase determination.
gaps.effect: All v3 areas are screening proxies and must not be labelled THLB or AAC.

gaps.detail: Forest-weighted treed slope shares from the 960 m screen are applied to v2 operable area inside a province/ecoprovince. The v2 screens are assumed independent of slope; this is not a pixel-exact intersection.
gaps.effect: Steep-area losses are overlay estimates, not spatially resolved exclusions.

gaps.detail: Slope is computed from 960 m average elevation. Local 30 m slope can be much steeper; this layer cannot classify operability, harvest system, or site degradation.
gaps.effect: >15% and >30% losses are screening sensitivities, not operational or legal classifications.

gaps.detail: MRDEM-30 is a DTM mosaic of HRDEM lidar and Copernicus GLO-30. Non-lidar areas are modelled and may have larger vertical error; the public STAC item has no source legend.
gaps.effect: Slope accuracy is not uniform across the country.

gaps.detail: 13,272,017.76 ha of SCANFI treed area lies outside the RSYC ecoprovince polygons. v2 assigns those blocks to the nearest ecoprovince, but the slope screen has no independent ecoprovince slope statistics for them.
gaps.effect: v3 inherits the v2 nearest-ecoprovince attribution and applies the receiving ecoprovince's slope share to those blocks; the 13.27 Mha gap is not zero-filled or separately resolved.

gaps.detail: The published slope overlay contains base and core20 only. v3 applies the same ecoprovince share to core30; there is no independent core30 overlay to reconcile against.
gaps.effect: core30 slope losses are internally consistent estimates.

gaps.detail: The v2 gap that no national DEM was present is superseded by the national 960 m MRDEM-30 slope screen used here.
gaps.effect: The residual limitations are captured in coarse_slope_not_operability, dem_source_mix, and slope_overlay_assumption.

gaps.detail: The NBAC bundle is the 2020 annual vintage only; 2010 and 2015 fire-history screens cannot be computed.
gaps.effect: Only the 2020 fire screen is represented in v2/v3.

gaps.detail: NRN is the public road network; resource, industrial, winter, and decommissioned roads are absent.
gaps.effect: Road distance is an optimistic public-road access proxy.

gaps.detail: SCANFI median age is a stand-age prediction; excluding stands below 20 or 30 years is a screening convention.
gaps.effect: Age screens reduce area beyond merchantability alone.

gaps.detail: The v1 managed share is uniform inside each province-ecoprovince; tenure is not intersected spatially.
gaps.effect: Spatial tenure pattern is not represented.

gaps.detail: SCANFI age is a 30 m prediction surface, not a provincial inventory or disturbance record.
NU and PE managed and operable values are blank because the 2016 tenure compilation has no coverage.
gaps.effect: Blank is not zero; national totals cover 11 provinces.

caveats: Screening proxy only; not a legal THLB, AAC landbase, or harvest feasibility test.
Slope losses use a forest-weighted ecoprovince share, not a pixel-exact intersection.
The 960 m slope layer smooths local terrain and is not a 30 m operability model.
The 13.27 Mha of SCANFI treed area outside RSYC ecoprovince polygons has no independent slope statistics; v3 inherits v2 nearest-ecoprovince attribution.
Slope >15% and >30% are screening thresholds, not provincial or legal rules.
NBAC 2020 is an annual fire vintage; 2010 and 2015 cases are gaps.
NRN public roads only; resource and industrial roads are absent.
NU and PE operable values remain blank, not zero.
The 100M/119M/150M intensities are target-volume / area arithmetic, not growth forecasts or sustainability tests.
nan_policy: Area fields are blank only where v2 coverage is unavailable (NU, PE); they are not zero.
